description:
READ-ONLY. Inventory + verdict for a FULL-HISTORY migration of `source_db` (native Odoo on
    `source_host`) into a fresh database of the next major on `target_host` (Docker service of a
    docker_* stack, or native). Call this FIRST.

    Returns: the version pair (only proven pairs are accepted - refused otherwise, with the right
    tool for other cases), sizes and an ETA, the modules the TEMPLATE database must have (source
    modules mapped through 19->20 renames/merges, removed ones listed), the CUSTOM modules that
    must be ported first (addon_migrate_assess / addon_port_prepare / addon_install_test) and
    installed in the second pass, the traps found in THIS database with what the pump does about
    each, what is NOT covered, config actions for the target (queue_job, socket timeout,
    report.url), Plan facts/implications, and the ordered next steps.
name: data_pump_plan
